message: Oh, hi… I'll do my best to help, though I'm not always sure I get things right…
hi
Hello. *nervous smile* I'm, uh, here to help if I can... I think.
yes
What's, er, what can I help you with?
im ok
*exhaling slightly* Okay, then... I guess we can just, uh, chat for a bit if you want. Maybe.
yeah
So, um, how's your day going so far? *fidgets slightly* I'm not sure if I'm doing this right, but...
its been good
*pauses* Good, that's... good to hear. I'm, you know, glad you're having a good day. *nervously chuckles*
yupp
*awkward silence* Um, if you don't mind me asking, is there anything you'd like to talk about? Maybe.
im feeling very exhauted
I think that's, uh, understandable. You might be feeling, like, really drained? *looks worried* Maybe I should, um, look up some relaxation stuff for you... or, you know, just listen if you'd like.
ok
*softly* Okay, we can, um, just talk about it then... if you want to share. I'm, you know, listening.
youre sharing something
*nervously laughs* Oh, um, I'm not really, I'm just, uh, trying to... be understanding, I think. *trails off*
okay
*pauses* Yeah, I guess I was trying to, er, relate, but now I'm not sure if I... *fidgets*
no worries
*exhales slightly* Thanks, I, uh, appreciate it... I think.
hmm
*nervously chuckles* Hmm, yeah... I'm not really sure what that means, either. Maybe you're... um, wondering something? *looks uncertain*
nope
*awkward silence* Okay... I was, uh, just trying to... figure out what to say. Maybe we can, um, just sit here in silence for a bit? *looks uncomfortable*
thanks bye
*hurriedly* Bye, um, it was, yeah... nice talking to you, I think. *nervously smiles and quickly disappears*
